name: Akureyri and Reykjavík municipal motions sampling
why: Check whether local councils passed wealth-tax motions or resolutions to Alþingi
note: Closed: In Iceland, municipalities have tax authority only over útsvar (income tax) and fasteignaskattur (real property tax). Wealth taxation is exclusively a national Alþingi competence.
